reviews.comment: This was one of the few courses that helped me visualize real field settings instead of just memorizing textbook material. Dr. Akkutlu is approachable and genuinely wants students to succeed. He makes lectures engaging despite dry material. Be aware of tough TA's grading. Labs are important and help with exams, which are based mainly on lectures.

Exams are just as he says in lecture. attend class and listen to what he says is important. he gives tons of hints on what will be tested and is always there after class for assisting. labs are a bit long but nothing too drastic.

He is one of the best. Super energetic and realyl cares about his students wanting to learn. Focuses more on wanting the students to learn the topics than worrying about exams, wants everyone to love the topic. Few homeworks and two exams. Exams are easy if you do the excersies and focus on basic topics, not meant to be tricky. One of the best!

The professor does not teach well the course, he has an ego problem, He doesn't have a good personality and thinks he's always right and doesn't listen to his students.I took his class and I wouldn't advise you to take him

Very simple guy, kept his class pretty streamlined and his TA Mengyue was one of the best I ever worked with. Very understanding and helpful. The class is important for the rest of the PETE degree and Dr. Akkutlu is a great professor to introduce you to these concepts. Exams were really easy and focused on the most important stuff.
He is just ego, he does not know many things about petroleum engineering. he knows just bits and pieces from different concepts.

Here's the situation: this class should not be even remotely hard. In defiance of all logic this professor absolutely despises formula sheets, and he will expect you to memorize every formula if you want to succeed on the quizzes and the final. These formulas are NOT easy to memorize and if you do not spend a good amount of time studying, good luck

No HW, a few quizzes, and some lab reports. He makes it sound easy, however: his "quizes" are really full length exams. they are HARD. if you dont pay attention, listen, work out the problems in class in detail, and ask questions you're screwed bc its ALL gonna be on the tests. He's not too sneaky, the tests are pretty much like the class problems.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Akkutlu is by far my favorite professor in my petroleum engineering career. He is a fantastic lecturer and really cares about his students LEARNING petrophysics. Go to class and get to know him because he memorized my name by the third class. Study for the quizzes by redoing the examples he does in ppts. Take Akkutlu and you won't regret it.

Dr. Akkutlu is so authentic, he really cares about students, his office is open almost anytime. Just be aware that you have to study hard to do good in this class. Don't skip class and take notes you'll regret not doing so! Would take him again for sure.

Dr. Akkutlu was a decent prof overall. No homework, only periodic quizzes (40% of grade) that he let the class determine the day of. Quizzes come straight from his PPTs. Lectures can range from interesting to dry, depends on the topic & day. Weekly lab & lab report. Difficult, cumulative final (40% of grade). Make flashcards & redo ppt examples!
